However, there are minor grounding artifacts where the paws of the leftmost dog blend slightly into the green floor (melting effect), and the green coloration on the fur appears somewhat uniform like a dye overlay rather than natural pigmentation. The pose auditor flagged MEDIUM risk due to low-confidence keypoints in hind limbs and faces, suggesting subtle anatomical ambiguities, but these do not constitute catastrophic failure. Overall, the image is visually convincing despite minor AI generation tells.
